event_name: Date 13 September 2020 Time 17:31 2020 TUSCAN GRAND PRIX 10 - 13 September 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Failure to enter the pit lane to the right of the white line contrary to the Race Directors' instruction, point 19.2 of the Event Notes.
offence: Breach of Article 12.1.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards viewed video evidence from multiple angles. Car 7 did not keep to the right and crossed the white line at the pit entry.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 7 Pit Entry
